raw_response:
The issuer shows a moderate ability to generate operating profits (EBIT of ~13.8% of revenue), and strong cumulative earnings support via large retained earnings. However, liquidity is weak (current ratio 0.91) and leverage is high (total liabilities ~74% of total assets), which elevates refinancing and cash-flow risk. Overall, these factors point to a credit quality in the lower investment-grade range.

DECISION: BBB-
